title: 宝塚記念の後に・キーワード②

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I beat you, you beat me not! I beat you, you beat me not!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship bests Tosen Jordan with the haughty triumph of a child on the playground! She also gets a new clue, so that's nice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They promise to have a rematch on a big stage next time. Meanwhile, the organizer of the search for Eden and the clues remains unknown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fans congratulate Gold Ship on her second consecutive victory at the Takarazuka Kinen. I can't be happier about the monumental achievement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship is over the moon. She buys red and white bean buns to celebrate, but only gives me the doughy parts…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship is proud of herself, but it seems my praise isn't enough, so she demands to be properly lauded. It's kinda cute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship is now ablaze. If she gets even hotter next year, she could very well char the starting gate beyond recognition. Please don't!
